svg.aria-label: The add mode of the roadmap skill: /roadmap add <goal>. Boxes: The file's format read (a step of the session); The draft: title, goal, gate and its answer, what it waits on, its place (a step of the session); No gate (stop); The level (stop); The insertion form (stop); A missing dependency (stop); The change (stop); Written and committed (a step of the session).
